name: Udenheim (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Udenheim (grapes on white above a bend and an eagle on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Udenheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Udenheim arms — grapes, bend and eagle
